safety.before_desc: Peit bniah ia ki dak pait ha ka khyndew, ki dieng ba phai, bad sngap ia ka jingpynbna sorkar.
safety.during_desc: Phet noh sha ki jaka ba rhem bad shngain. Wat leit sha ki surok ba don lum ha krung.
safety.after_desc: Wat leit mar mar sha ka jaka ba twad namar ka lah ban twad biang. Iarap ia kiba mynsaw.
safety.do1: Peit bniah lada ka um wah ka kylla rong jabieh kynsan (ka pyni ba don kiba twad sha jrong).
safety.do2: Phet mardor lada sngew kumba khrum u lum, don dieng kiba pait, ne maw kiba them.
safety.dont1: WAT leit jam ia ki jingkieng ba dap um, ki mori ba dheng, ne ki surok lum ba la khang.
safety.dont2: Kieng ban shong ha ki kamra plymeng kiba don harud ki lum ba kham thyrnia haba jur slap.
